feed.title: Lab Canary: Google DeepMind updates
feed.subtitle: Changes to Lab Canary's ratings of what's publicly known about AI lab staff contracts, speak-up policies and contracts with outside evaluators.

entry.title: Google DeepMind: Google says new hires' non-disparagement terms no longer apply after they leave
entry.summary: Google told the Washington Post on 3 November that it had recently removed "the post-termination aspect of non-disparagement clauses" from its terms for new hires, and that it doesn't enforce non-disparagement clauses after people leave. "No gag on criticism" now cites this and stays "Falls short": Google only described removing the part that applies after someone leaves, it didn't say existing contracts had changed, and the new wording isn't public. If Google publishes the wording, it will be rated on that wording. Scores are unchanged.

entry.title: New beta tab: what's public about labs' contracts with outside evaluators
entry.summary: A second tab rates what's public about each lab's contracts with third-party evaluators, using the six terms in GovAI's proposal that these contracts be published: scope, access, publication rights, pay, conflict rules, and term and renewal. Anthropic scores 42% and OpenAI 33%, mostly "Partly" from their own announcements; Google DeepMind, xAI and Meta score 0% because nothing is public. No lab has published a full evaluation contract. These scores are separate and don't change the staff-contract scores.

entry.title: Google DeepMind: a former researcher posts the non-disparagement clause he signed
entry.summary: Andreas Kirsch, a former Google DeepMind research scientist, posted on X a clause from the agreement he signed with Google in the UK in 2024. It says staff must not make "any statement" "criticising or disparaging Google", during or after employment, and he says it has no exemption for protected disclosures. "No gag on criticism" now cites it as its main source and stays "Falls short". A new entry for "Protected disclosures carved out" stays "Not public", because the rest of the agreement isn't public. Scores are unchanged.

entry.title: Lab Canary launched
entry.summary: Five labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI and Meta) rated on public evidence against seven clauses.
